# EMI Options

EMI is available on credit cards from major banks for orders above 3000 rupees. You can choose 3, 6, 9 or 12 month plans at checkout.

No-cost EMI is available only on selected products marked "No Cost EMI" on the product page.

Debit card EMI is not available. EMI ka interest aapka bank charge karta hai, QuickKart nahi.

# Prices and Offers

Prices on QuickKart can change at any time. You pay the price shown when you place the order.

We do not offer price matching with other websites, and we do not refund the difference if the price drops after you order.

Bank offers apply only if you pay with the bank's card and the order meets the offer's minimum value. Offer ki details checkout par dikhti hain.

# Return Window

You can return most items within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused, with tags attached and in its original packaging.

- Electronics can be returned within 7 days only if they are in the original box with all accessories.
- Innerwear, personal care items, and perishable goods cannot be returned.

Return request karne ke liye My Orders mein jaakar Return par click karein.

# Track Your Order

After your order ships, we send a tracking link by SMS and email. You can also go to My Orders and tap Track.

Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after shipping. Thoda time lag ho sakta hai.

# Exchange Policy

Clothing and footwear can be exchanged for a different size within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused with tags attached.

Exchange is only for a different size of the same product. You cannot exchange for a different product or colour; place a return and a new order instead.

Each order item can be exchanged only once. Size exchange ke liye My Orders mein jaakar Exchange par tap karein.
